text: Subject Overview This discipline takes the efficient and clean development, production, conversion and utilization of energy as its application background and ultimate goal. It mainly studies the basic laws of energy transformation, transmission and utilization in the process of converting or reversing energy from forms such as heat, light, potential energy and kinetic energy to forms such as work and electricity As well as the theories and technologies for the design, manufacture and operation of equipment and systems that effectively implement these processes in accordance with this rule. It serves as the theoretical foundation of energy and power engineering, featuring a high degree of interdisciplinary integration and a close combination of theory and engineering practice
